remedies.title: Ask to be put back on the roll with Form 6
remedies.plain: If your name was left off the draft or the final roll, fill in Form 6, the application to be added to the roll. During the claims and objections period of the revision it goes with the declaration attached to it for the revision. Once the revision is over in your state you can still apply at any time under continuous updation, on the ordinary Form 6 of the 1960 Rules. Form 6A is for Indian citizens living abroad, and Form 8 is for a change of address or a mistake in your own entry.
steps: Get Form 6 from your booth level officer (BLO), the registration officer's office, voters.eci.gov.in or the ECINet app.
During the revision, attach the declaration that goes with Form 6 for the revision.
Hand it to the BLO or the registration officer, or file it online, and keep the reference number.

Know what the ordinary Form 6 asks you to sign. It is titled “Application Form for New Voters”, and item (iii) of its declaration says “I am applying for inclusion in Electoral Roll for the first time and my name is not included in any Assembly Constituency/ Parliamentary Constituency.” The Commission's letter of 1 October 2026 tells booth level officers to help people who are no longer on the roll apply through Form 6, its Manual on Electoral Rolls of March 2023 says a person no longer on the roll has to apply again through Form 6 as a new elector, and section 23(1) of the 1950 Act lets anyone not on the roll apply. No Commission document found says how a person who was on a roll before should answer item (iii). Section 31 of the 1950 Act punishes only a statement the person knows or believes to be false, or does not believe to be true, with up to one year in prison, a fine or both, and no court ruling or prosecution for signing item (iii) to get back on the roll has been found. On 14 October 2026 the Delhi High Court closed a petition by two electors left off Delhi's roll, one of whom said that filing Form 6 would be a false declaration. The Commission's standing counsel had suggested Form 6 on the Electoral Registration Officer's instructions, and on that ground the Court said his fear of being accused of a false declaration was misplaced and that they could file Form 6, to be processed in accordance with law. The order does not mention item (iii) or section 31, and it does not decide the petition's challenge to the SIR guidelines.
Apply well before an election is called. No name can be added after the last date for nominations until that election is over.
Use Form 8 if you moved house, within the state or from another state, or if your entry has a mistake. Use Form 6A if you live abroad on an Indian passport.

remedies.title: Objections and the hearing before any deletion
remedies.plain: Form 7 is the form for objecting to a name on the roll, or to a name proposed to be added. When someone objects to your name, the registration officer has to send you a notice and hear you before deciding. Before deleting a name on the ground that the person has moved away or is not entitled to be on the roll, the officer has to give that person a reasonable chance to be heard. In the revision no entry could be deleted from the draft without an inquiry and a fair chance to be heard, followed by a written order with reasons. If you get a notice, go to the hearing or send the documents asked for, and ask for the order in writing.
steps: Check the lists of claims and objections the registration officer puts up on the notice board and the Chief Electoral Officer's website.
If someone has objected to your name, you should get a notice with the date, time and place of the hearing.
Attend in person or through someone you authorise where that is allowed, and take your documents.
Ask for the registration officer's decision in writing. You need it for an appeal.

remedies.title: Appeal to the District Magistrate, then to the Chief Electoral Officer
remedies.plain: If the registration officer's decision goes against you, you can appeal to the District Magistrate under section 24 of the Representation of the People Act, 1950. If the District Magistrate's order also goes against you, a second appeal lies to the state's Chief Electoral Officer. The Commission's revision order kept both appeals and gave 30 days from the District Magistrate's order for the second. The Chief Electoral Officer of Goa, in the note on its final roll, gave 15 days from the registration officer's decision for the first.
steps: Get a copy of the registration officer's order.
Write a short appeal to the District Magistrate, signed by you, with the order attached, within 15 days of the registration officer's decision.
If it is turned down, appeal to the Chief Electoral Officer within 30 days of the District Magistrate's order.
Keep copies and receipts of everything you hand in.

remedies.title: The 1950 helpline, complaints, and the drive to find those left off
remedies.plain: You can call the voter helpline on 1950, or the national toll-free number 1800-11-1950 from 8 am to 8 pm, and every complaint is logged on the National Grievance Service Portal. The ECINet app has a Book-a-Call with BLO feature, and complaints can also be emailed to complaints@eci.gov.in. After the revision, the Commission ordered BLOs to compare the roll from before the revision with the present one, visit those missing, and help anyone still eligible fill in Form 6. The lists are to be shared with the parties' booth agents, and booth level camps are to be held. Special camps may also be held for people in night shelters and labour colonies and for the homeless.
steps: Call 1950, or 1800-11-1950, and note the complaint number.
Use Book-a-Call with BLO on the ECINet app to ask your BLO to visit.
If a BLO visits during the drive, fill in Form 6 then and there if you are eligible.
Look for booth level camps in your area, and special camps if you live in a night shelter or labour colony.

remedies.title: Free legal help from the legal services authorities
remedies.plain: Under section 12 of the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987, women, children, members of Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes, people with disabilities, industrial workers, victims of disaster and people below an income limit set by each state can get free legal help. Legal services include advice and help before any authority, so they can cover a claim, a hearing or an appeal about the roll. Ask at the District Legal Services Authority at the district court, or call the NALSA helpline on 15100. In Bihar in September 2025 the Supreme Court had the legal services authorities send para-legal volunteers to help voters file claims and objections online.
steps: Call 15100 or visit the District Legal Services Authority office at the district court.
Say that your name was left off the roll and what stage you are at (claim, hearing or appeal).
Take the notice or order you received and any documents you have.
Ask for a para-legal volunteer or panel lawyer to help you fill in the form or the appeal.

remedies.title: What the Supreme Court's orders give an elector
remedies.plain: In Bihar the Court had the roughly 65 lakh names left off the draft published booth by booth, with the reason for each, searchable by EPIC number and put up at panchayat and block offices. It allowed claims with a copy of Aadhaar and then made Aadhaar the twelfth document, as proof of identity. In West Bengal it let people flagged for discrepancies file through an authorised representative, gave them ten more days, and set up appellate tribunals of former judges for those whose claims judicial officers rejected. Its judgment of 27 May 2026 upheld the revision and said that people in Bihar whose names were, in its words, "erroneously deleted" as absent, dead, shifted or duplicate may challenge the decision in court.
steps: Search the list of names left off by your EPIC number on the district or Chief Electoral Officer's website, or look at the panchayat or block notice board.
Note the reason given against your name. It tells you what to answer.
Aadhaar can be given as proof of identity. It is not accepted as proof of citizenship.
In West Bengal, a rejected claim goes to the appellate tribunal. A pending appeal did not give a right to vote at the 2026 poll.

remedies.title: Going to court
remedies.plain: An elector can ask the High Court, under Article 226 of the Constitution, to review a decision on the roll. The Supreme Court's judgment of 27 May 2026 says the Commission's enquiry into eligibility remains open to judicial review, and that people in Bihar whose names were, in its words, "erroneously deleted" as absent, dead, shifted or duplicate may challenge the decision that way. On 11 November 2025, while it was hearing the challenges to the revision, the Supreme Court asked the High Courts to hold back cases on whether the revision was valid. That request did not cover an elector's own case about his or her own entry. The judgment of 27 May 2026 decided the petitions about Bihar, and the petition in which the request was made is not among the cases it lists.
steps: Use the claim, the hearing and both appeals first, and keep every order.
If you still have no remedy, ask the District Legal Services Authority for a lawyer to file a writ petition in the High Court.

hi.A citizens' collective of groups working: मज़दूरों और प्रवासियों के साथ काम करने वाले समूहों का एक नागरिक मंच, जिसने दिल्ली भर की मेहनतकश बस्तियों में हेल्पलाइन और आमने-सामने के हेल्प डेस्क चलाए, मतदाताओं की प्रोजेनी मैपिंग और फ़ॉर्म में मदद की, और उनके मामले मुख्य निर्वाचन अधिकारी तक ले गया।
hi.A coalition that trained volunteers to r: एक गठबंधन जिसने बेंगलुरु में SIR हेल्पलाइन और हेल्प डेस्क चलाने के लिए स्वयंसेवकों को प्रशिक्षण दिया, मुख्य रूप से प्रवासियों, झुग्गी-बस्ती निवासियों, ट्रांस लोगों, मुसलमानों, दलितों और आदिवासियों के लिए, और 2002 की मैपिंग और फ़ॉर्म में मदद की। इसने शिकायतें मुख्य निर्वाचन अधिकारी तक भी पहुँचाईं।
hi.A community organisation of trans people: उत्तर दिनाजपुर में ट्रांस लोगों का एक सामुदायिक संगठन, जिसने कहा कि उसका ध्यान SIR पर और उसके दौरान अपने समुदाय की मदद पर था, हालाँकि अप्रैल 2026 तक यह काम धीमा पड़ गया था।
hi.A decision can be appealed twice, first: किसी फ़ैसले के ख़िलाफ़ दो बार अपील की जा सकती है, पहले ज़िला मजिस्ट्रेट के पास और फिर राज्य के मुख्य निर्वाचन अधिकारी के पास।
hi.A forum formed at PUCL Chhattisgarh's ca: PUCL Chhattisgarh के आह्वान पर SIR की समस्याओं से निपटने के लिए बना एक मंच। इसने स्वयंसेवकों को प्रशिक्षण दिया, जागरूकता बैठकें कीं और ख़ास समस्याएँ मुख्य निर्वाचन अधिकारी तक ले गया, जिन्होंने एक BLO के ग़लत भरे फ़ॉर्म दोबारा भरवाने का आदेश दिया।
hi.A name left off can be put back. Form 6: छूटा हुआ नाम वापस जोड़ा जा सकता है। इसके लिए फ़ॉर्म 6 भरा जाता है, पुनरीक्षण के दौरान भी और उसके बाद किसी भी समय, किसी चुनाव में नामांकन की अंतिम तिथि से दस दिन पहले तक।
hi.Aadhaar can be given as proof of identit: आधार पहचान के प्रमाण के रूप में दिया जा सकता है। इसे नागरिकता के प्रमाण के रूप में स्वीकार नहीं किया जाता।
hi.After the SIR, began a door-to-door driv: SIR के बाद, चार विधानसभा क्षेत्रों में डायोसीज़ के 40,750 परिवारों में उन लोगों को ढूँढने के लिए, जो मतदाता सूची से छूट गए या कभी दर्ज ही नहीं हुए, प्रशिक्षित युवा स्वयंसेवकों का घर-घर अभियान शुरू किया, जिसकी शुरुआत एक पैरिश से हुई। चर्च के नेताओं ने कहा कि ऐसे कम से कम 3,000 लोगों की पहचान की गई थी।
hi.Among the church bodies that organised h: उन चर्च संस्थाओं में से एक जिन्होंने हैदराबाद में मतदाताओं को गणना फ़ॉर्म भरने में मदद के लिए हेल्प डेस्क लगाए।
hi.Among the church bodies that set up help: उन चर्च संस्थाओं में से एक जिन्होंने पूरे हैदराबाद में प्रशिक्षित स्वयंसेवकों वाले हेल्प डेस्क लगाए, ताकि मतदाताओं को गणना फ़ॉर्म भरने में मदद मिले।
hi.An elector can ask the High Court, under: कोई मतदाता संविधान के अनुच्छेद 226 के तहत उच्च न्यायालय से मतदाता सूची से जुड़े किसी फ़ैसले की समीक्षा करने को कह सकता है। सर्वोच्च न्यायालय का 27 मई 2026 का फ़ैसला कहता है कि पात्रता की आयोग की जाँच न्यायिक समीक्षा के लिए खुली रहती है, और बिहार में जिन लोगों के नाम, फ़ैसले के शब्दों में, अनुपस्थित, मृत, स्थानांतरित या दोहरी प्रविष्टि बताकर "ग़लती से विलोपित" किए गए, वे इसी रास्ते से उस फ़ैसले को चुनौती दे सकते हैं। 11 नवंबर 2025 को, जब सर्वोच्च न्यायालय पुनरीक्षण को दी गई चुनौतियों की सुनवाई कर रहा था, उसने उच्च न्यायालयों से अनुरोध किया कि वे पुनरीक्षण की वैधता से जुड़े मामलों को रोककर रखें। यह अनुरोध किसी मतदाता के अपनी प्रविष्टि से जुड़े अपने मामले पर लागू नहीं होता था। 27 मई 2026 के फ़ैसले ने बिहार से जुड़ी याचिकाओं का निपटारा किया, और जिस याचिका में यह अनुरोध किया गया था, वह उस फ़ैसले में सूचीबद्ध मामलों में शामिल नहीं है।

hi.Attend in person or through someone you: ख़ुद जाएँ, या जहाँ इसकी अनुमति हो वहाँ अपने अधिकृत किसी व्यक्ति के ज़रिए, और अपने दस्तावेज़ साथ ले जाएँ।
hi.Call 15100 or visit the District Legal S: 15100 पर फ़ोन करें या ज़िला अदालत में ज़िला विधिक सेवा प्राधिकरण के दफ़्तर जाएँ।

bn.You can call the voter helpline on 1950,: আপনি ভোটার হেল্পলাইন 1950-এ ফোন করতে পারেন, অথবা সকাল 8টা থেকে রাত 8টা পর্যন্ত জাতীয় টোল-ফ্রি নম্বর 1800-11-1950-এ, এবং প্রতিটি অভিযোগ ন্যাশনাল গ্রিভ্যান্স সার্ভিস পোর্টালে নথিভুক্ত হয়। ECINet অ্যাপে Book-a-Call with BLO নামে একটি সুবিধা আছে, এবং complaints@eci.gov.in ঠিকানায় ইমেল করেও অভিযোগ জানানো যায়। সংশোধনের পরে কমিশন বুথ লেভেল অফিসারদের (BLO) নির্দেশ দেয় সংশোধনের আগের ভোটার তালিকার সঙ্গে বর্তমান তালিকা মিলিয়ে দেখতে, যাঁদের নাম নেই তাঁদের কাছে যেতে, এবং যাঁরা এখনও যোগ্য তাঁদের ফর্ম 6 পূরণে সাহায্য করতে। এই তালিকাগুলি রাজনৈতিক দলগুলির বুথ এজেন্টদের দিতে হবে, এবং বুথ স্তরে শিবির করতে হবে। রাতের আশ্রয়কেন্দ্র (নাইট শেল্টার) ও শ্রমিক কলোনির বাসিন্দা এবং গৃহহীনদের জন্য বিশেষ শিবিরও করা যেতে পারে।
